prompts.logo: Create a polished standalone app logo symbol for a Chinese multi-role interview practice platform named 映答 (Reflective Answers). SYMBOL ONLY, NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, no wordmark. A distinctive compact interlocking pair of folded speech ribbons forming a small aperture/reflection, one indigo #4d5ac7 ribbon and one periwinkle #a5b4ef ribbon. Calm intelligent confident design, refined almost-vector flat filled mark, generous negative space, readable at 24px, crisp silhouette. Balanced centered square composition, symbol fills about 78% of canvas, truly transparent background. No surrounding tile, no drop shadow, no mockup, no sparkle stars, no robot head, no microphone. This is a production web app logo matching a pale blue-white editorial interface.
prompts.careers: Wide landscape editorial illustration for 映答, a calm multi-role technical interview practice web app. NO TEXT OR LETTERS anywhere. A beautifully composed miniature interview rehearsal studio in soft isometric perspective: three diverse young adult professionals quietly preparing around a curved pale-blue table, one showing a laptop with abstract UI rectangles, another studying a small book, another explaining a branching data diagram on a freestanding board. Discreet visual cues for frontend development, Python/data, software testing, and engineering: neat code-like colored lines without readable characters, a small database cylinder, a magnifying lens, a plant. Sophisticated tactile paper-cut / soft matte clay hybrid illustration, rounded architectural forms, indigo #4d5ac7, periwinkle #a5b4ef, cool pale background #f6f8ff, tiny restrained warm apricot accents. Bright diffuse daylight, polished premium educational editorial art, generous breathing room, not a stock corporate handshake, no humanoid robot, no gradients as background, no sparkles. Horizontal composition approximately 3:2, people and studio grouped on right two thirds, left one third quiet pale ground for optional adjacent HTML caption. Fill image with an intentional scene, medium detail readable at 600px wide.
prompts.knowledge: Wide 3:2 landscape editorial illustration for a technical knowledge and interview question library within the Chinese app 映答. Absolutely NO TEXT, letters or numbers. A carefully designed small tabletop landscape: an open pale indigo book in foreground, a curved path made of small index cards rising gently toward three sculptural rounded archive shelves, neat abstract tabs and branching connections, a tiny magnifying lens resting beside the book, one small deep-blue sphere and a warm apricot bookmark. The concept is connecting scattered knowledge into a clear route, for several software professions, not just Java. Soft matte paper / refined clay illustration, calm natural light and delicate ambient occlusion, blue-purple #4d5ac7, lavender-periwinkle #a5b4ef and very pale cool blue #f6f8ff. Clean editorial composition, tangible crafted objects, restrained detail, premium and friendly, plenty of clean pale background at edges. No logo, no UI mockup, no floating text bubbles, no robots, no neon. Designed to sit at right of a light web page heading or above a login panel; do not draw a frame.
